integration.check: Own aggregate parent 1.3 acceptance. Verify every child preserves its existing local baseline and supplies pre-fix behavior-failure evidence before repairing its assigned boundaries. Require source revision, bounded command, scenario or fixture, expected behavior and failing assertion for every reproduction. Verify authority evidence covers public native/foreign permission, identity and governed tools. Verify recovery evidence covers memory/PostgreSQL acquisitions, checkpoints and public Send, Resume, recovery and Attach. Verify provider evidence covers controlled HTTP through Build/native conversations and the Eino public foreign constructor. Verify sandbox evidence covers public Sandbox/Workspace attacks, setup failures and immutable snapshots. Verify network evidence covers public HTTP tool/egress CGNAT and divergent proxy DNS with controlled positive controls. Verify release evidence covers declared-dependency conformance and semantic tools/apicheck fixtures. Keep dependency availability, lint diagnostics, compilation failures, missing commands and infrastructure failures separate from behavior reproductions. Cross-check the complete evidence set against every approved parent public boundary. Reject missing or unevidenced boundaries rather than accepting one child's subset as aggregate proof. The integration acceptance belongs to the parent, not the first child, and requires no implementation ordering change.

Own parent 9.1. On the tree containing all six integrated children, run bounded task tools:test, task lint, task spec, task test, task examples:test and task api:check. Verify every required registered scenario executes with behavior evidence and none is skipped or flaky. Verify the regenerated docs/design/types.md is clean. Check all eight capability contracts, scenario ownership, ADR and cumulative docs/changelog edits coexist. Public provider and Eino calls must retain exact approval identity, reserved journal keys and cumulative recovery accounting. Focused commands use three-minute process/two-minute Go limits. Full module/store commands use twenty-minute process/ten-minute Go limits. Use two package workers, two parallel tests and two lint workers. Preserve configured cache/temp paths. Allow one fixture repair and at most two diagnostic reruns per failing boundary. Never count a flaky retry as acceptance.

Own parent 9.2. Run full isolated PostgreSQL/store conformance and relevant native/store/adapter race checks on the combined tree within the parent bounds. Prove Start/resume/reclaim exclusion, database-time ownership, one token-fenced acquisition winner, old-token refusal and consume/lease crash recovery. Verify empty Continue consumption, eligible-before-limit discovery and no human-approval auto-resume. Observe redacted record-before-delivery and exactly one terminal boundary through fresh Attach. Combine governed provider identities with resumed prepaid calls and exact downstream keys. Inject Docker setup/publication failures and verify trusted helper cleanup, immutable content and preserved workspace ownership. Use controlled network peers and allowed-peer positive controls. Do not use public DNS or internet listeners. Preserve all existing assertions.

Own parent 9.3. Run task spec:gate GATE=M2 without lowering the existing milestone floor. Report unrelated existing blockers separately. Run the implemented verification-only adapter release task across every landed adapter with GOWORK=off, no replacements, published availability/checksums, tidy cleanliness and conformance. Confirm workspace examples use task examples:test and never satisfy an independent release verdict. Verify optional PostgreSQL methods use released parameter/result types without an unpublished-interface assertion. Verify API baseline/candidate graphs remain separate and any historical correction is verified, printed and confined to the approved temporary baseline requirement. No third-party upgrade, tag or publication may result. Unresolvable published dependencies leave this acceptance incomplete.

Own parent 9.4. Reconcile all twenty-four findings against implementation, public regression assertions and remaining risks. Findings 1-6 belong to authority, 7-14 to recovery, 15-18 to providers, 19-20 to sandbox, 21-22 to network and 23-24 to release. Preserve all five original research-report edits and their independent ownership. Verify every parent row has exactly one primary acceptance owner and all integrated dependencies preserve shared files, directories and mutable contracts. Confirm frozen method sets remain unchanged, the root remains standard-library-only and no unrelated architecture, third-party upgrade, release, tag rewrite or production migration entered the tree.
